records.plant_name: Perryman Gas LLC project (PJM queue C01-1579)
records.monitor_reason: 555 MW gas queue entry at Perryman that is probably Constellation Project 2, already in GEM, but the queue number is not yet tied to the GEM record.
records.researcher_notes: A 555 MW natural gas project by Perryman Gas, LLC entered the PJM queue on April 25, 2026 as C01-1579, connecting at the Perryman 115 kV substation in Harford County, with an in-service target of December 15, 2029. GEM already has Constellation Project 2 at Perryman (L100001080791, 564 MW) and Constellation Project 1 (L100001080785, 150 MW); the Public Service Commission's December 30, 2025 order approved both for the expedited permit route and set a filing deadline of July 1, 2027. The 555 MW figure and the 2029 target match Project 2 closely, so this is most likely the same project under a project company name and should not be added as a new plant. Recheck after the certificate application is filed, which will name the project company; then the queue number can be recorded on the existing GEM record.

records.monitor_reason: Army selected Ameresco to build natural gas generation at Aberdeen Proving Ground, but no capacity, site or schedule has been given.
records.researcher_notes: The US Army announced on September 18, 2026 that it conditionally selected Ameresco for a lease to build commercial power generation at Aberdeen Proving Ground in Harford County. Ameresco's press release of September 21, 2026 says it plans to deploy natural gas generation first and later a Terrestrial Energy molten salt reactor. Neither the Army nor the company gave a megawatt figure, a site within the base or a schedule beyond a goal of operating by 2030, and the lease is still being negotiated. This is separate from the Army's own 9.2 MW gas microgrid at the base, which is under the 50 MW threshold. Recheck for the signed lease, an air permit or a PJM queue entry.
